The bumper cars are great for participants at least 40" who can ride next to an adult operating the bumper cars, or alone they must be 42". texts.awesome-entertainment-of-ohio-awesome-fa:
Bring big laughs, friendly competition, and nonstop energy to your event with our awesome Pig Races Interactive Ride! Kids, Teens, and Adults will LOVE!
This unique attraction features three side-by-side racing lanes where riders sit on their own colorful “race pig” and pump the handles to power their way to the finish line. The faster you pump, the faster your pig races—making every round exciting for both participants and cheering spectators.
Awesome for company picnics, school events, festivals, fundraisers, and backyard parties, this crowd-favorite creates instant engagement and keeps lines moving with quick, repeatable races.
It’s easy to understand, fun for a wide range of ages, and encourages playful competition between friends, coworkers, and family members.
Whether you’re looking to add a midway-style experience or a standout interactive centerpiece, this carnival attraction delivers memorable moments and plenty of photo opportunities.

Make your event more magnificent with a Merry Go Round!
Our Carousel Ride will remind you of your childhood -- and you'll want to introduce your next generation to this old-fashioned fun.
This adorable ride turns in a circle with young riders astride 6 vintage carousel animals. Suitable for children ages 1 to 8 years old, your smallest guests will feel comfortable on this gentle ride. Parents may stand next to a child if needed.
Our Carousel Ride is awesome for festivals, birthday parties, picnics, mall events, church socials, corporate picnics or other memory-making special occasions.

Hang Ten or WIPEOUT!
Both young riders and professional surfer dudes will enjoy our Mechanical Surfboard Ride Simulator.
Speeds are manually controlled on this mechanical ride, so younger kids enjoy a gentler ride. Then more adventurous riders can brave the barrel of the waves, honing their surf skills for the North Shore of Oahu.
Our Mechanical Surf Amusement Ride comes with an inflatable mat that looks like a wave, a control box for different speed levels and an attendant for your event.
This deluxe surfboard simulator carnival ride is one of our hottest rides and offers an awesome challenge to players who want something different from the traditional sports competitions.

Beep! Beep! for Bumper Cars!

These battery-powered beauties are the only easy-to-use portable bumper cars on the market. This carnival ride makes any event awesome!

Each of our 3 bumper cars can have 2 drivers, making this an especially fun option for pairing adults with children. Features include:

Remote control start and stop
Lights on front and rear
1 to 5 minute timer
Easy to use on almost any hard, flat surface
Indoor and outdoor use

These cars travel with their own inflatable bumper car track, making them awesome for street fairs, family parties, post-proms, school events, corporate parking lot parties, church gatherings, holiday celebrations, Bar Mitzvah and Bat Mitzvah, trade shows and any other event that will rev up your guests' engines for fun.

Shake up your celebration with our Rock N Roll amusement ride!

Up to 4 riders sit inside this carnival ride, spinning back and forth -- and even upside down!

This awesome gyroscope-style ride is self propelled, so it's an excellent option for locations without easy access to power -- because there's no electricity required! It's also a great way to include a popular "green energy" element at any event.

NOTE: Ride is mounted on a trailer and must be driven to exact event site.

This amusement attraction is ideal for company picnics, birthday parties, church events, Rock N Roll themed events, fundraisers, trade shows, school carnivals, community festivals and any special oocasion.

Our battery-operated Trackless Train Ride rental is Wheelchair Accessible, so guests using physical accommodations, such as transport chairs, walkers and canes, can enjoy the ride.
Designed as a scaled-down version of an actual train, this electric train ride has 3 passenger cars and an engine at the front. One seating compartment converts to fit a wheelchair, when needed.

When planning your event, please note our Trackless Train operates best on hard, flat, firm and even surfaces. This ride can NOT be used on lawns, ice, gravel, sand, snow or uneven surfaces.

texts.janesky-brothers-amusements--back-spin-r:
The Back-Spin Roller Coaster is a spinning roller coaster on steel track designed to deliver a thrilling and unpredictable ride experience. The four coaster cars hold a total capacity of 16 riders. One of the key advantages of this modern attraction is its advanced passenger restraint system, designed to securely hold riders throughout the experience. The pull-down shoulder restraints securely hold passengers in place throughout the ride.

Once boarded, the coaster vehicles begin a controlled pre-spin while still in the station. After leaving the station, the vehicles maintain their spinning action as they are propelled up the lift hill. At this point, each vehicle is allowed to spin freely based on passenger weight distribution, meaning every ride cycle delivers a unique experience. After cresting the hill, the coaster descends while spinning through a drop, enters a helix, and then travels into a deceleration lane before returning to the station.
texts.janesky-brothers-amusements--bumper-cars:

This rental includes 16 electric bumper cars, each seating two riders, allowing up to 32 participants per ride cycle. All cars are electric-powered and extremely energy efficient, making them ideal for both indoor and outdoor events.
The bumper car attraction requires a level setup area with a footprint of approximately 60 ft x 60 ft, totaling 3,600 square feet—about the size of a small commercial building.
These are the same full-size bumper cars you’d expect at a permanent amusement park or carnival. With 16 cars running per cycle, accommodating 32 riders every 5–6 minutes, the ride can handle 300+ riders per hour, making it an excellent choice for high-attendance events.
texts.janesky-brothers-amusements--carousel:

With a ride capacity of approximately 200 guests per hour, this is a true high-volume amusement ride designed to keep crowds moving efficiently. The ability to load all 16 riders at once ensures quick turnaround times while remaining enjoyable for guests of all ages. Small children may ride alongside a supervising adult, subject to ride operating procedures.
The carousel features 10 hand-painted, moving horses, along with 2 zebras, 2 giraffes, and a stationary chariot that seats 2–3 guests—perfect for riders who prefer a still option. texts.janesky-brothers-amusements--fun-house:

Standing nearly 40 feet tall, our Fun House creates instant visual impact with bright colors, flashing lights, classic carnival styling, and the mystery of what guests will discover inside.
Inside the Fun House, guests experience a variety of classic carnival elements, including a moving staircase, the rocking room, moving walkways, ramps, fun house mirrors, and elevated views overlooking the midway or event space.
One of the most iconic features is the rotating barrel, a classic fun house element where guests walk through a spinning tunnel before exiting the attraction. These interactive features make the Fun House more than just a ride; they create a walk-through amusement experience that encourages laughter, photos, and lasting memories.
texts.janesky-brothers-amusements--funnel-forc:

texts.janesky-brothers-amusements--spidermania:

SPIDERmania's design incorporates two orbital motions which often prevents dizzy feelings among riders and making for a very comfortable, smooth ride. In fact, many people who ride get right back in line to do it again.

SPIDERmania requires approximately a 50-foot circular setup area and stands about 30 feet tall. The ride can be installed on asphalt, concrete, or firm, dry grass, making it suitable for a wide variety of event venues.

SPIDERmania is a family ride and is intended for both adults and children 36" and taller.

A powerful sound system, siren, air horns, and colorful lighting help create the classic carnival atmosphere that makes this ride such a standout attraction at fairs, festivals, corporate events, and large public gatherings.
While many thrill rides have higher minimum height requirements, the Himalaya is designed to accommodate eligible riders 36 inches and taller, making it a great option for families and events with mixed age groups.
Each of the 16 ride cars can accommodate up to three passengers, depending on seating configuration. Once guests are seated, lap bars are secured before the ride begins. Unlike traditional spinning rides, the Spider combines multiple movements into one unforgettable experience. As the central hub rotates, each ride car spins independently while the arms rise and fall throughout the ride cycle. The constantly changing motion creates an exciting combination of speed, elevation changes, and centrifugal force that keeps riders coming back for another ride.
The Spider ride features 12 ride arms, each seating two passengers, for a total capacity of 24 riders per cycle.

Turbo Tubs move you around, but the spinning is up to you. 24 can enjoy this exciting family ride.
24 riders per ride
36 foot by 36 foot area
30 inches tall to ride alone, may ride with an adult if fewer than 30 inches tall.
texts.the-bounce-house-company-st-louis--45-fo:
Our headline attraction. Our crew anchors the base and guides every load.
Capacity: 36 enclosed gondolas, up to 4 riders each (1,440 lbs per gondola)
Footprint: 60 ft x 60 ft, plus 30 ft overhead clearance
Riders: under 42 in must ride with an adult
texts.the-bounce-house-company-st-louis--amuse:
Nine lanes wide, so groups race each other instead of queuing single file. Riders climb a carpeted stairway and come down on a tube. It moves a crowd faster than almost anything else we carry.
Lanes: 9 parallel lanes, 30 ft tall
Access: non-slip stairway with handrails
Riders: one per tube, dispatched as each lane clears
texts.the-bounce-house-company-st-louis--carni:
Chairs on chains under a lit canopy, swinging out in a wide arc. Color-changing LEDs make it the ride people photograph after dark. We carry two versions: a gentle set for younger guests and a high-speed Ballistic swing for older riders.
Seats: 6 chairs with an overhead canopy
Motion: 16 ft arc radius, up to 12 rpm
Riders: at least 48 in tall
texts.the-bounce-house-company-st-louis--kiddi:
A first Ferris wheel, sized for small riders. Six open buckets turn gently, high enough to feel like an adventure and low enough that nobody changes their mind at the top.
Capacity: 6 buckets, 2 riders each (300 lbs per bucket)
Height: 12 ft, gentle rotation speed
Riders: minimum 36 in, no unaccompanied toddlers
texts.the-bounce-house-company-st-louis--track:
Electric, so it runs quietly and indoors as easily as out. Useful for moving guests between zones at a spread-out festival, and it needs no track, just a clear route.
Cars: locomotive plus 3 passenger cars
Capacity: seats up to 18
texts.the-bounce-house-company-st-louis--tubs-:
Four lanes of tube slide that run wet or dry, so the same ride works for a July festival or an October fall fest.
Lanes: 4 wet or dry lanes, 20 ft tall
Tubes: 40 in inner tubes with handles, one rider each
texts.wold-amusements--americana-wheel:
Spin around and enjoy the height of spectacular views as the Americana rotates to view the midway
Must be 48" to Ride or 42" with an Adult.
texts.wold-amusements--black-widow:
Riders are able to control the spin of their free swinging ride vehicle using a giant turntable. As the ride begins to spin, it lifts into the air on a slight angle. Riders can enjoy a gentle swinging ride or spin as fast as their arms allow.
Must be 48" to Ride or 42" with an Adult.
texts.wold-amusements--cars:
Choose from any car, truck or motorcycle to drive around and enjoy the fair
Must be 36" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--convoy:
Pick a big truck to take a ride around the track
Must be 36" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--crystal-lil-s:
Take a stroll through the two story glass house and slide onto the midway
Must be 42"
texts.wold-amusements--ekg:
The EKG consists of a circular horizontal platform with a vertical cage-like wall around the edge. The platform is attached to a motor on a hydraulic arm. The ride starts out by spinning until the centripetal force is enough to push riders against the wall. Then the arm raises the horizontal platform to a vertical position in which riders, instead of spinning horizontally, are now spinning almost vertically.
Must be 48" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--elephants:
Fly sky high on an Elephant!
Must be 36" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--ferris-wheel:
The Ferris wheel is a ride consisting of a giant vertical revolving wheel with passenger cars suspended on its outer edge.
Must be 48" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--go-gators:
Go Gator coaster is lots of fun with twists and turns!
Must be 36" min and 52" max
texts.wold-amusements--hall-of-horror: Are you up for a fright? Ride in a cart through the Hall of Horrors for some thrills and chills...
texts.wold-amusements--lolli-swings:
The Lolli Swing is a unique family swing ride that features double bucket seats that allow two people to ride next to each other. As the candy themed ride begins to rotate, it raises in the air and osculates with a tilting motion!
Height Requirements
36" with an adult
42" alone
texts.wold-amusements--merry-go-round:
The key to the midway! Take a ride on the Merry Go Round, this nostalgic ride is fun for all ages .
Must be 32" to ride or 42" with an Adult
texts.wold-amusements--new-york:
This Fun House is full of surprises as the floors shift, roll and spin!
Must be 36" to Ride. Under must be with an Adult.
texts.wold-amusements--pirate-s-cove:
Argh! Pirate's Cove is an obstacle course with punching bags, rope climbs, and a fast slide down to exit the ride.
Must be 36" to Ride. Under must be with an Adult.
texts.wold-amusements--scooters:
Ready, Set ,Go! Choose a car put on your seatbelt and get ready to drive !
Must be 48" to Ride or 42" with an Adult.
texts.wold-amusements--ski-doo:
Take a light ride on the ski lift swings
Must be 36" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--sky-fighters:
Take an old fighter plane and soar around in the air
Must be 36" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--speed-boats:
Troll around on the boats that go around the circle and up and down as if to be going over real waves
Must be 36" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--spin-the-apples:
Take a seat and spin the turntable to your speed as these apples twirl in circles
Must be 42" or 36" with an Adult
texts.wold-amusements--starship:
The ride is completely enclosed, with 48 padded panels lining the inside wall. Riders lean against these panels, which are angled back. As the ride rotates, centrifugal force is exerted against the pads by the rider, removing the rider from the floor, due to the slant.
Must be 42" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--super-slide:
Grab a sack and head down the slide. Go down solo or race your family and friends!
Must be 42" to Ride (No Lap Rides)
texts.wold-amusements--swings:
Fly free as this swing set spins round and round in circles throughout the air.
Must be 44" to Ride.
texts.wold-amusements--viper:
The Viper twists and twirls riders in multiple directions while rotating on an angle. As the spindles rotate, the seats swing outwards.
Must be 44" to Ride with an Adult
48" without an Adult
texts.wold-amusements--wrecking-ball:
Hold on tight as the Wrecking Ball swings and spins
Must be 42" to Ride
texts.wold-amusements--zipper:
Each cage rotates freely on an off-centre axis, while the cages (connected to a cable) move around the main boom at 4 rpm.
Must be 52" to Ride, No Single Riders.
